title: Luxury Christmas AI Animated Short Film – Classic 2D Disney-Inspired Style
desc: I’m looking for a talented AI animation filmmaker or small creative studio to produce a high-quality, cinematic Christmas animated short film for a luxury Parisian haircare brand. Project concept: The film celebrates the opening of a new Paris salon on December 1. The story follo…
full:
I’m looking for a talented AI animation filmmaker or small creative studio to produce a high-quality, cinematic Christmas animated short film for a luxury Parisian haircare brand.

Project concept:

The film celebrates the opening of a new Paris salon on December 1.

The story follows a famous Parisian hairstylist, his real white bull terrier, and the extraordinary decorative animals from his salon: a large ostrich, white peacocks, and a leopard.

On a magical Christmas night, the decorative animals secretly come alive and join the dog on an enchanting adventure through snowy Paris, ending at the beautiful new salon.

Visual style:

Traditional Disney-inspired 2D hand-drawn animation, similar to classic animated films such as The Aristocats and 101 Dalmatians, with the sophisticated cinematic atmosphere of luxury Christmas advertisements by Dior, Prada and Coca-Cola.

I want elegant character animation, beautiful hand-painted Parisian backgrounds, warm Christmas lighting, expressive animals and consistent character designs.

Deliverables:

* A complete 30–45-second animated Christmas film
* Consistent animated characters based on real photographs
* Professional cinematic animation and storytelling
* Background music and sound effects with commercial usage rights
* Professional editing and colour grading
* Final video in vertical 9:16 format, minimum 1080p
* One or two rounds of revisions

AI-assisted production using tools such as Kling, Runway, Midjourney or similar is welcome.

I will provide the story, character photographs, salon references and visual inspiration.

Important: I am looking for a complete finished film, not just character illustrations or static AI images.

Please share examples of previous AI-animated films in a similar 2D style, your fixed total price, and your estimated delivery time.

I would prefer to begin with a paid 5-second animation test before proceeding with the full project.

This is a private creative concept and should remain confidential.

title: Design LoRaWAN RTU & concentrator With RS232/485
desc: I need an experienced embedded engineer to design and program a long-range LoRaWAN remote terminal unit that can both monitor field sensors and issue remote control commands. The unit must expose one RS-232 and one RS-485 interface so it can collect data from legacy instruments w…
full:
I need an experienced embedded engineer to design and program a long-range LoRaWAN remote terminal unit that can both monitor field sensors and issue remote control commands. The unit must expose one RS-232 and one RS-485 interface so it can collect data from legacy instruments while also talking Modbus devices and driving actuators.

Core expectations 
• Stable LoRaWAN Class A/C operation over several kilometres in open field conditions. 
• Dual-purpose firmware: periodic sensor polling plus immediate downlink command handling with confirmable acknowledgements. 
• Hardware design ready for manufacture, including schematic, PCB layout, BOM and enclosure recommendations. 
• Clean, well-documented code (C/C++ or Embedded C) that I can recompile in STM32CubeIDE or a similarly accessible toolchain. 
• Simple configuration utility or serial AT command set for network keys, baud rates and register maps.

Acceptance criteria 
1. Prototype demonstrates successful data uplink and downlink in a real gateway network. 
2. RS-232 and RS-485 ports are verified with test devices for both polling and control commands. 
3. Source files compile without warnings and handover package is complete.

Time is critical—I would like to see the first working prototype and compiled firmware as soon as possible, so please outline a realistic schedule when you respond.

Our goal is to reach people genuinely interested in artificial intelligence, software development, technology and the future of building applications.

Target Audience

- Software developers and aspiring developers.
- AI enthusiasts and technology professionals.
- Startup founders and entrepreneurs.
- No-code and low-code builders.
- People interested in learning how to build applications using AI.

Marketing Responsibilities

- Promote the book through relevant websites, blogs and online communities.
- Create and distribute engaging promotional content.
- Use SEO and content marketing to attract interested readers.
- Promote the book through relevant social media channels.
- Identify suitable technology communities, newsletters and influencers.
- Generate targeted visitors to the book's sales page.
- Encourage genuine purchases rather than just clicks or impressions.

Affiliate Commission Opportunity

This project includes an affiliate-based compensation opportunity.

Each selected marketer will receive a unique affiliate tracking link. Sales generated through that link will be attributed to the respective marketer.

Commission: 30% per confirmed sale.

Current book pricing:

- Introductory price: $3.39
- Regular price: $5.27

Commission is calculated using the actual purchase price paid by the customer.

Marketers who demonstrate strong results may be considered for longer-term promotional partnerships.

Commission Payment Terms

- Commissions are earned on completed and confirmed purchases generated through the affiliate's unique tracking link.
- Refunded, cancelled or fraudulent transactions are excluded.
- Sales will undergo a 14-day verification period to account for refunds and disputes.
- Commission payments will be made monthly, between the 5th and 10th of the following month.
- A minimum accumulated commission balance of $5 is required for payout.
- Payments will be made through an agreed and supported payment method.

Requirements

- Previous experience in digital marketing, affiliate marketing or book promotion is an advantage.
- Ability to reach relevant technology and AI audiences.
- Strong content creation and promotional skills.
- Understanding of organic traffic generation and conversion.
- Ability to provide evidence of previous campaigns or results.

Important Conditions

- No bots, fake traffic, click farms or artificial engagement.
- No spam or unsolicited mass messaging.
- No misleading claims or unauthorised discount promises.
- Only genuine, trackable purchases qualify for commissions.
- Marketing activities must comply with the rules of the platforms being used.
- Affiliates must disclose their promotional or commission relationship where required.

How to Apply

Please include:

1. Your proposed marketing strategy.
2. Your experience promoting books or digital products.
3. The channels and audiences you can reach.
4. Examples of previous campaigns, where available.
5. Your expected deliverables and proposed campaign timeline.

Our objective is simple: reward marketers for bringing genuine readers and generating actual book sales.

full:
Estamos buscando un diseñador gráfico y audiovisual con experiencia en creación de invitaciones digitales animadas y videos para eventos religiosos.

Somos una imprenta y empresa de diseños personalizados. Necesitamos desarrollar dos videos de Primera Comunión: uno para niño y otro para niña.

**OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL**

Crear dos videos elegantes, modernos y profesionales que funcionen como plantillas maestras editables. Estos videos serán utilizados comercialmente para ofrecerlos a nuestros clientes, por lo que necesitamos poder personalizarlos posteriormente sin depender del diseñador.

### 1. VIDEO PARA NIÑO
- Temática: Primera Comunión.
- Estilo elegante, moderno, delicado y religioso.
- Colores: celeste, blanco, perla y dorado.
- Elementos: cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo, ángeles y detalles decorativos.
- Animaciones profesionales y transiciones suaves.

### 2. VIDEO PARA NIÑA
- Temática: Primera Comunión.
- Estilo elegante, delicado, femenino y religioso.
- Colores: rosado pastel, blanco, perla y dorado.
- Elementos: flores, cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo y detalles decorativos.
- Animaciones delicadas y transiciones suaves.

### 3. REQUISITO FUNDAMENTAL: PLANTILLAS EDITABLES

Este punto es indispensable para contratar el servicio.

Necesitamos recibir los archivos originales y editables de ambos videos, preferentemente en Canva, CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro u otra plataforma que permita modificar fácilmente:

- Nombre del niño o niña.
- Fecha de la Primera Comunión.
- Hora y lugar de la ceremonia.
- Nombre de los padres y padrinos.
- Fotografías del niño o niña.
- Textos y frases religiosas.
- Música, cuando corresponda.
- Otros detalles personalizados.

La edición debe ser sencilla, de modo que nuestro personal pueda modificar los datos de cada cliente y generar un nuevo video sin conocimientos avanzados de edición.

**No buscamos solamente dos videos terminados en MP4. Buscamos dos plantillas maestras reutilizables y editables.**

### 4. ENTREGABLES
1. Video final de Primera Comunión para niño en MP4.
2. Video final de Primera Comunión para niña en MP4.
3. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niño.
4. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niña.
5. Archivos originales del proyecto y recursos utilizados.
6. Enlaces de edición o duplicación de las plantillas, si se trabaja con Canva.
7. Breve tutorial de cómo cambiar los datos y fotografías.

### 5. ESPECIFICACIONES
- Formato vertical 1080 x 1920 píxeles (9:16), ideal para WhatsApp, Instagram y redes sociales.
- Buena resolución y calidad profesional.
- Animaciones fluidas.
- Tipografías elegantes y legibles.
- Música y recursos con licencia que permita su uso comercial.
- Sin marcas de agua.

### 6. PERFIL DEL FREELANCER
Buscamos una persona que tenga experiencia en:
- Diseño de invitaciones digitales animadas.
- Edición de videos para eventos.
- Motion Graphics.
- Canva, After Effects, Premiere Pro o CapCut.
- Creación de plantillas editables y reutilizables.

**IMPORTANTE:** Al presentar su propuesta, agradeceremos adjuntar trabajos anteriores, indicar qué programa utilizará y confirmar que entregará las plantillas originales editables, con los derechos necesarios para su personalización y uso comercial.

Buscamos una relación de trabajo profesional y posiblemente nuevos proyectos de diseños para nuestra empresa.

title: Upscale and Update 200 Apparel Photos
desc: Job Title: High-Quality Photo Upscaling (Topaz Gigapixel) & Apparel Brand Logo Update (Photoshop) – ~200 Images Budget: $300.00 USD Maximum (Fixed Price) Project Description: We are looking for a detail-oriented photo editor to update our brand logo across approximately 200 activ…
full:
Job Title: High-Quality Photo Upscaling (Topaz Gigapixel) & Apparel Brand Logo Update (Photoshop) – ~200 Images
Budget: $300.00 USD Maximum (Fixed Price)
Project Description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented photo editor to update our brand logo across approximately 200 activewear studio photos (all provided photos feature the existing logo to be updated).
Please read the full description carefully before applying. Our maximum budget for the entire project is strictly $300.00 USD (including revisions as needed). Kindly do not submit proposals above $300.00 or automated bids that ignore these requirements, as we want to respect everyone's time.
Quality is our #1 priority. Because the original files are standard JPEGs and the logo sits at a small scale directly on the clothing, applying our updated logo onto un-upscaled images causes severe pixelation when zoomed in or enlarged. To ensure crisp, realistic results, the old logo must be removed first, each image must be upsized 4x in Topaz Gigapixel, and then the updated logo must be applied in Photoshop. The final logo must look naturally printed onto the fabric and match the photo's resolution so there is zero artificial pixelation when zoomed in.
Scope of Work:
1. Remove Old Logo First (Photoshop): Open the original JPEG images in Adobe Photoshop and cleanly retouch out/remove the previous brand logo from the clothing so the fabric texture looks completely clean and untouched.
2. Image Upscaling Second (Topaz Gigapixel): Run all ~200 cleaned images through Topaz Gigapixel AI at 4x resolution, creating clean fabric texture and enough pixel density to keep small logo lines and text sharp. Keep Face Recovery OFF (or at minimal settings) so the model’s face, skin, and details remain completely natural and true to the original.
3. Apply Updated Logo Third (Photoshop): Open the 4x upsized images in Adobe Photoshop and place our updated brand logo as a Vector Smart Object (or high-res Smart Object).
4. Realistic Fabric Alignment, Wrapping & Blending: Rotate and slightly warp the logo to match the angle of the seams and natural curve of the body/fabric. Where a logo sits near an outer edge (such as the curve of a hip or leg), cleanly mask/clip the wrapping edge so it follows the contour naturally instead of looking pasted on flat. Match the lighting and contrast of the clothing so the logo looks naturally printed on the garment.
5. Preserve Original Photo & Model: Do not alter the colors, lighting, skin tones, or appearance of the model, clothing, or background in any way. Only the resolution and brand logo should be updated.
6. Match Photo Sharpness & Zoom Behavior: Zoom in closely on every finished image to verify that the logo's sharpness matches the fabric and photo itself. When zoomed in, the logo and the photo must soften or lose detail naturally together—the logo should never break into harsh pixel blocks faster than the rest of the image.
7. Revisions Included: Revisions must be provided as needed at no additional cost until all images meet our placement, blending, and sharpness standards.
What We Will Provide:
• ~200 original JPEG activewear photos (organized in folders)
• High-resolution updated brand logo files (Vector .AI / .SVG / .EPS and/or .PNG)
• Brand placement guidelines (or reference examples)
Deliverables:
• ~200 finished, 4x upscaled images saved as High-Quality JPEGs (Quality 10–12), maintaining the exact original file names, extensions, and folder structure.
Budget & Payment Milestones ($300.00 USD Maximum – Revisions Included):
• Milestone 1 ($20.00): Complete and pass approval on a 10-image test sample (including any revisions needed) before starting the full batch.
• Milestone 2 ($140.00): Delivery and approval of the next 100 finished images (including any revisions needed).
• Milestone 3 ($140.00): Delivery and approval of the remaining 90 finished images (including any revisions needed).
Mandatory Requirements:
• Topaz Gigapixel (Required): Must own and use Topaz Gigapixel AI (4x upscale with Face Recovery turned off).
• Adobe Photoshop (Required): Must use Adobe Photoshop with Smart Objects, Warp/Transform, and Layer Masks for natural apparel placement (no basic online editors or mobile apps).
• Zero Pixelation Standard: Submissions showing pixelated logos, jagged thin lines, blurry edges, or compression artifacts will not be accepted.
• Strict Color & Subject Preservation: Must maintain exact original colors and make zero edits or retouching to the model or background.
• Revisions Policy: Must include revisions as needed to fix any alignment, warping, or quality issues prior to milestone release.
• File & Folder Integrity: Must preserve exact file names and folder organization.
To Apply:
Please reply with:
1. Confirmation that you accept the $300.00 USD fixed budget, milestone structure, and revisions as needed.
2. Confirmation that you have active access to both Topaz Gigapixel and Adobe Photoshop.
3. Confirmation that you understand the 3-step workflow (remove old logo → 4x Topaz upscale → apply updated logo) and apparel warping/edge-masking requirements.
4. Your estimated turnaround time for 200 images and a brief example of similar apparel/product photo editing work.

I'm looking for an experienced YouTube Shorts creator who understands what makes videos go viral and knows how to turn gaming content into highly engaging, high-performing Shorts.

The content will be centered around KreekCraft playing GTA 6, and I need someone who understands both YouTube's algorithm and the gaming content niche.

What I'm Looking For

I need someone who can do more than just edit clips. You should have a strong understanding of viral content strategies, YouTube SEO, audience retention, and Shorts optimization.

Your responsibilities will include:

Researching viral YouTube Shorts in the gaming niche, especially GTA and Roblox content.

Studying successful creators and analyzing what makes their videos perform well.

Identifying viral trends, formats, hooks, titles, and editing styles that can be adapted into original content.

Finding the most entertaining, funny, surprising, or attention-grabbing moments from KreekCraft's GTA 6 gameplay.

Creating strong hooks within the first 1–2 seconds to capture viewers' attention.

Editing Shorts to maximize audience retention, engagement, and replayability.

Writing optimized titles, descriptions, and relevant hashtags.

Understanding YouTube SEO and how to position videos for maximum discoverability.

Constantly researching what's currently working and adapting the content strategy accordingly.

Required Experience

Proven experience creating or editing successful YouTube Shorts.

Strong understanding of YouTube Shorts growth and algorithm optimization.

Excellent knowledge of audience retention, storytelling, and viewer psychology.

Ability to research viral videos and identify patterns behind their success.

Experience with gaming content is highly preferred.

Creative thinking and the ability to recognize viral opportunities in raw gameplay footage.

Important

I'm NOT looking for someone who simply adds captions, cuts clips, and uploads videos.

I want someone who actively researches, studies successful videos, understands why they went viral, and applies those strategies to create content with viral potential.

You should be constantly looking for ways to improve performance rather than repeatedly using the same editing formula.

When Applying, Please Include:

Examples of YouTube Shorts you've edited or helped grow.

Any channels you've worked with and their results.

Your experience with YouTube SEO and Shorts optimization.

How you research and analyze viral videos.

What strategies you would use to grow a GTA 6 gaming Shorts channel.

The goal: Build a successful YouTube Shorts channel by consistently producing highly engaging content with strong viral potential.

MUST INCLUDE: 

Every clip must include KreekCraft's overlay and drive viewers back to his livestream!

The official KreekCraft logo overlay must remain clearly visible throughout the entire clip. Clips without it will be rejected.

Only use KreekCraft's official GTA 6 livestreams and stream replays. Content from unrelated games or other creators is prohibited.

Every clip must include "Watch KreekCraft on YouTube and Twitch" in the caption.

Every post must include #GTA6 #KreekCraft #GrandTheftAutoVI.

At least 40% of viewers must come from the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, or Australia.

Every clip must maintain at least a 0.8% engagement rate. Likes must remain publicly visible.

Clips must be entertaining, properly edited, and feature strong hooks within the first 1–2 seconds. Low-effort screen recordings and random gameplay are prohibited.

Only submit original edits. Stolen clips, reuploads, fabricated context, fake reactions, and misleading titles are prohibited.

Do not post the same or nearly identical clip more than 5 times. Story boosting, artificial views, and engagement manipulation are prohibited.

Every clip must remain publicly available for at least 30 days.

Only TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts are eligible.

New accounts must follow the warmup process. All clippers must read the approval process and Tier 1 audience-targeting guide before submitting.

title: WooCommerce Store Build & Setup

full:
I’m ready to launch a full WooCommerce storefront for a range of physical products that will be shipped to customers. The core of the job is getting a clean, reliable e-commerce experience online—everything from the initial WordPress/WooCommerce install to that satisfying “order complete” email hitting the customer’s inbox.

Key requirements 
• Product catalogue structured for physical goods, with clear categories and variable product support if sizes, colors, or similar options are needed later. 
• Shipping zones, methods, and rates configured so customers see accurate costs at checkout. 
• Secure online payments via card and PayPal integrated and fully tested—no sandbox leftovers. 
• Responsive layout that looks crisp on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Feel free to propose a premium theme or a lightweight custom design; what matters is speed and an intuitive user journey. 
• Essential pages (cart, checkout, account, privacy, terms) set up and styled to match the overall look. 
• Confirmation emails, invoice templates, and order status flow verified so buyers can follow their purchase from payment through delivery.

Acceptance criteria 
1. I can add a product, set stock, and run a test purchase from browse to email receipt without errors. 
2. Card and PayPal transactions appear in WooCommerce orders with the correct status and details. 
3. Shipping charges display accurately for at least two sample destinations. 
4. Google PageSpeed Insights scores 85+ on mobile for the storefront homepage. 

Once those boxes are ticked, the site goes live. If you’re confident with WooCommerce best practices and can deliver a polished, conversion-focused store, let’s get started.

I have a high-resolution photo that I want transformed into a buildable, LEGO-style wall portrait. The final display should sit comfortably on a medium-sized wall area—think several standard baseplates wide and tall—yet remain light enough to hang with ordinary picture hardware. 

Here is what I need from you: 
• A design that combines standard LEGO bricks with a small set of custom 3D-printed elements where standard pieces do not exist. The custom pieces should solve any colour, shape, or connection challenges that off-the-shelf bricks can’t handle while still locking to regular studs. 
• The model must be split into clearly numbered sections or panels so I can print, build, and transport it in manageable chunks, then click everything together for the final reveal. Model should be broken into multiple Lego sized pieces rather than less bigger pieces.
• A complete building guide (PDF or Stud.io instructions) that walks through each step, plus a parts list that distinguishes between LEGO parts and the custom files I’ll need to print. 

Sample image attached. Real image will be supplied once job starts.

Please keep stud alignment clean and avoid fragile half-stud offsets wherever possible. If you work in Stud.io, LDraw, Blender, or Fusion 360, just let me know which file formats you’ll deliver so I can open and review them. Once approved, I’ll take care of printing and brick sourcing on my end. 

If this sounds like your kind of project, I’m ready to share the reference image and get started right away.

Final acceptance hinges on the artwork being both engaging for the target age group and technically accurate in depicting: waiting at the bus stop, boarding and riding, and crossing close to the bus—elements that will appear across the series. 

If you love bringing friendly characters to life and are comfortable refining work through constructive feedback, this project sets the foundation for a long-term collaboration on the rest of the Billy Rides the Bus series.

desc: INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX Video 1: Recepción del vehículo Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12 Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días. 1. Objetivo del proyecto Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos. Este p…
full:
INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX

Video 1: Recepción del vehículo

Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12
Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días.

1. Objetivo del proyecto

Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos.

Este primer video será una prueba de calidad. Si el cliente aprueba el resultado, continuaremos con los otros cinco tutoriales, cada uno con su correspondiente versión en inglés.

El objetivo es enseñar al usuario cómo realizar la recepción de un vehículo dentro del software, de manera sencilla, visual y dinámica.

2. Estilo audiovisual que buscamos

El cliente quiere un resultado:

- Limpio, moderno y profesional.
- Dinámico, pero sin exceso de efectos.
- Visualmente atractivo y fácil de comprender.
- Con apariencia de producción audiovisual profesional, no de video genérico generado por IA.
- Con transiciones suaves y movimientos de cámara digitales bien utilizados.
- Con una narración humana en español latino neutro.

Importante: Evitar plantillas genéricas, efectos innecesarios, animaciones exageradas y elementos que distraigan de la explicación.

La prioridad es que el usuario entienda perfectamente lo que está viendo.

3. Estructura del primer tutorial

Duración objetivo: entre 45 y 60 segundos.

El video debe explicar el proceso de recepción de un vehículo siguiendo el orden real de utilización de la plataforma.

Secuencia de contenido:

1. Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
2. Mostrar el inicio del proceso de recepción del vehículo.
3. Enseñar cómo registrar la placa del automóvil.
4. Mostrar cómo asociar el vehículo con el cliente.
5. Explicar el registro de los daños y las observaciones.
6. Mostrar la parte más importante: las fotografías del vehículo.
7. Enseñar cómo guardar la recepción y finalizar el proceso.

4. Escena más importante: fotografías del vehículo

Esta parte requiere especial atención.

El cliente quiere que se muestre una persona real tomando las siete fotografías del automóvil en el orden solicitado por la aplicación.

La secuencia debe comunicar visualmente lo siguiente:

- Una persona toma las siete fotografías del vehículo.
- Se muestra cómo se van incorporando las fotografías a la aplicación.
- Se visualiza cómo se completa cada espacio.
- Se termina mostrando la cuadrícula final con las siete fotografías organizadas.

Esta escena debe quedar especialmente bien integrada con la grabación de pantalla. No debe parecer una simple presentación de imágenes.

5. Grabación y edición de pantalla

Se debe trabajar directamente con la cuenta demo de Tallerix.

Durante la grabación:

- Mostrar claramente cada acción.
- Mantener el cursor visible.
- Aplicar zoom en botones y campos importantes.
- Utilizar resaltados para orientar al usuario.
- Evitar movimientos bruscos.
- No mostrar información innecesaria.
- Mantener una buena legibilidad de los textos de la aplicación.

La edición debe seguir exactamente los pasos documentados por el cliente, respetando los nombres de los botones y las funcionalidades.

6. Narración y subtítulos

Para este primer video:

- Voz en off humana en español latino neutro.
- Tono profesional, natural y explicativo.
- Narración sincronizada con cada acción.
- Subtítulos en español correctamente sincronizados.
- Música de fondo discreta, sin competir con la voz.

No utilizar voz artificial en esta primera versión.

7. Identidad de marca

Incluir:

- Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
- Colores y elementos gráficos de su identidad corporativa.
- Cierre breve con el logotipo.
- Mensaje obligatorio: «Prueba gratis 14 días en tallerix.app».

Mantener una identidad visual consistente durante todo el tutorial.

8. Cierre del proceso

Al finalizar la recepción, el cliente quiere que se muestre cómo, al guardar el registro, el propietario del vehículo recibe por WhatsApp:

- La hoja de recepción en PDF.
- Su enlace de seguimiento.

Es importante representar este resultado de manera clara y comprensible.

9. Entregables

Para esta primera prueba:

- Video final en español.
- Formato horizontal 16:9.
- Adaptación vertical 9:16.
- Archivo MP4.
- Archivo editable del proyecto.
- Subtítulos sincronizados.

La versión en inglés se realizará después de la aprobación del cliente.

10. Condiciones de producción

- Tiempo máximo: 2 días.
- Presupuesto: USD 12.
- Respetar las indicaciones y funcionalidades reales de Tallerix.
- Cuidar especialmente la calidad de la narración, la sincronización y la presentación visual.
- No inventar pasos ni funcionalidades.
- Priorizar la claridad y la calidad sobre la cantidad de efectos.

11. Proyección del proyecto

Este es el primer video de una serie de seis tutoriales.

Si el cliente aprueba esta primera pieza, continuaremos con:

- Adaptación del primer video al inglés.
- Producción de los otros cinco tutoriales.
- Versiones en español e inglés de cada uno.
- Adaptaciones horizontales y verticales.

IMPORTANTE: Este primer video es nuestra oportunidad para demostrar calidad y conseguir la continuidad del proyecto. Necesitamos entregar una pieza que realmente destaque por su presentación, claridad y acabado profesional.

It’s a very visual book, and every page has a graphic or illustration: technical diagrams, infographics, corporate forms, warning signs, schematics, maps and in-world propaganda.

The writing is final and many graphics are already drafted. We need a strong graphic designer to refine the existing visuals and create new ones so the book has one consistent, polished look. You’ll work side by side with the creator at a WeWork for a full 8-hour day, with direct feedback and quick decisions. If you love world-building, sci-fi aesthetics and detailed graphic work, this is a rare chance to help shape the look of a real published book.

What you’ll do

Refine and polish the existing graphics for around 200 pages, which are 50–70% done: cleaner linework, a consistent style, better colour and finer detail
Create new graphics and illustrations for around 50 pages from finished text and briefs
Design in-world visual elements such as technical diagrams, infographics, icons, schematics, corporate forms, warning labels, maps and propaganda-style posters
Build and maintain a reusable visual system in Figma (components, icon sets, colour and type styles) so every page looks like it comes from the same “corporation”
Make fast changes based on feedback during the day
Keep Figma files organised and well named so they’re ready for final page layout and print later

Skills you’ll use
Figma · Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Photoshop · Vector Illustration · Infographics & Data Visualisation · Iconography · Technical / Diagrammatic Illustration · Colour Theory · Typography · Visual Consistency

Who can apply

A portfolio with graphics and illustration work is a must: infographics, diagrams, icon sets, posters, game or UI art, or world-building pieces
Comfortable working in Adobe Illustrator and Figma (components, styles and auto layout are a plus)
Strong eye for detail, and able to keep one consistent style across a large volume of graphics
Interest in sci-fi, games, retro-futurism or dark satire is a big plus

Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner

Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems

Location
Costa Rica  

Function / Dept
Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

Director, Enterprise Applications

Position Summary

6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals.

This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes.

Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences.

• Marketing and commercial judgment. You understand B2B buyer journeys, lead generation, conversion optimization, and how website decisions support marketing and sales outcomes.

• Resourcefulness and ownership. You enjoy getting into the details, finding solutions, and shipping improvements. You also know when a problem needs a specialist or cross-functional partner.

full:
I’m producing a high-end, black-and-gold fashion spot that will run in a wide 16:9 format for our website and YouTube channel. The concept centres on a single model in a flowing black silk couture gown, draped with a gold necklace and matching earrings. She moves slowly, owning the runway with a bold, powerful presence, and ends in a strong, held pose that lets the audience feel every ounce of confidence. 

Your task is to capture that journey with smooth, realistic camera motion. We open on a warm golden wash that skims the silk fabric; as the model approaches, the camera glides in to showcase the gown’s texture before settling into a dramatic close-up on the jewellery bathed in controlled, cinematic lighting. No captions, no logos—just pure visual storytelling and impeccable fabric physics. 

To keep the focus where it matters, the model’s walk and final pose must be the hero moments, with lighting, colour grading, and depth of field all reinforcing the luxurious mood. The jewellery should read sharp and undistorted; any lensing or motion work should stay elegant, never gimmicky. 

Deliverables 
• Finished 16:9 master video (ProRes 422HQ or equivalent, 4K preferred) 
• A graded reference LUT or .drp if colour is handled in DaVinci Resolve 
• Clean audio bed or silent master, ready for our soundtrack overlay 
• Project files or camera raw (if shot digitally) for archival

Acceptance criteria 
• Black and golden palette maintained throughout, no colour spills 
• Fabric reacts naturally—no clipping or unnatural physics if CG is involved 
• Jewellery remains crisp; reflections complement, never distort 
• Camera motion butter-smooth; no jitter or handheld shake 
• Final export free of captions, logos, or watermarks

If this brief aligns with your expertise in luxury fashion cinematography—whether you’re shooting on RED, Alexa, or crafting a fully CG sequence in Unreal or Blender—let’s craft something truly striking.

full:
Freelance Shopify Developer & UI/UX Designer Required – Premium E-commerce Store for Packaging Solutions Brand

Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced Shopify Developer / E-commerce UI/UX Designer to design and develop a premium, visually appealing, and fully functional Shopify online store for a packaging solutions company.

We want a storefront inspired by the design philosophy of IKEA's website – clean, minimal, modern, aesthetic, and highly intuitive, with a strong focus on product presentation, category-based navigation, and seamless shopping experience.

The objective is to create a professional e-commerce experience that makes product discovery effortless while reflecting the quality and versatility of our packaging solutions.

Project Estimate Cost: 3K

Scope of Work
1. Shopify Store Setup
 - Set up and configure the Shopify store.
 - Select and customize a suitable Shopify theme.
 - Ensure responsive design across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

2. UI/UX Design & Customization
 - Create an IKEA-inspired storefront with a clean, premium, and minimal aesthetic.
 - Design an engaging homepage with visually appealing banners and product sections.
 - Implement intuitive navigation and category-based product discovery.
 - Focus on whitespace, typography, product imagery, and structured layouts.

3. Product & Category Integration
 - All product listings, descriptions, and relevant content will be provided.
 - Organize products into appropriate categories and collections.
 - Create attractive product listing and detail pages.
 - Implement product filters, search, and sorting functionality.

4. E-commerce Functionality
 - Shopping cart and checkout configuration.
 - Payment gateway integration.
 - Product enquiry / bulk order functionality, wherever required.
 - Basic SEO configuration and essential Shopify settings.

5. Testing & Deployment
 - Cross-device and browser compatibility testing.
 - Performance and usability optimization.
 - Final deployment of the live Shopify storefront.

Design Reference
Primary Reference: IKEA – https://www.ikea.com/

We are looking for a similar design approach, not a direct copy. The store should have:
- Minimal and premium visual language.
- Strong product-focused layouts.
- Large, high-quality lifestyle and product imagery.
- Clean typography and intuitive navigation.
- Well-structured product categories.
- A polished and seamless shopping experience.

What We Are Looking For
- Proven experience developing Shopify e-commerce stores.
- Strong UI/UX and visual design capabilities.
- Experience customizing Shopify themes and Liquid.
- A good understanding of responsive design and e-commerce conversion principles.
- Ability to deliver a polished, production-ready storefront.

Deliverables
- Fully functional Shopify online store.
- Customized homepage, collection pages, and product pages.
- Complete product and category integration.
- Responsive design.
- Configured e-commerce functionality.
- Final testing and deployment.

To Apply
Please share:
1. Your Shopify portfolio or links to stores you have developed.
2. Examples of premium/minimal e-commerce websites you have designed.
3. Your proposed approach and recommended Shopify theme/technology.
4. Estimated project timeline.

Note: Product data and listings are already available. Our primary focus is on exceptional storefront design, UI/UX, and professional Shopify implementation.

Title: Social Media Content Creator (Pizza industry)
Location: Remote (candidates must be located in the United States)
Company: Fortune 100 Food & Beverage Manufacturing (FuseGlobal has worked with this company for 20 years)
Initial term: 12 months (position expected to run longer)
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 35 hours per week; Up to 25% travel (once per quarter)

Love Pizza? Love Creating Bold And Edgy UGC Food Content?

Let’s Cook.

About This Role: 

We are searching for a motivated self-starter with a passion for producing engaging video and static content for social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram for two of our pizza brands. The ideal candidate is confident both on and behind the camera, savvy in graphic design for the digital space, and hyper-creative. They have a sharp eye for online trends, a genuine passion for the food industry, and are fired up about pioneering new creative tactics to drive engagement with Gen Z and millennial consumers. And, most importantly, they must love pizza!

We're looking for candidates who have experience with making food the star of the content through prep, food style, etc (bonus points for frozen food/pizza experience!). Ideally candidates are comfortable being both on camera talent when needed, but also experience making the food the central piece to the content in an edgy and bold style.

What You'll Do:

• Social Listening: Perform listening across channels to identify relevant trends and opportunities for content that allows the brands to drive engagement and relevancy.

• Develop and Pitch Creative Ideas: Generate and present innovative concepts for both static design and lo-fi lifestyle video content to be published on TikTok and Instagram that ladder back to brands’ strategy.

• End-to-End Content Creation: Design, produce, edit, and write post copy for all social content across TikTok and Instagram. Some content will be adapted for use in paid media campaigns, so an understanding of creative best practices for paid social is a plus.

• Perform On-Camera: Serve as on-camera talent as needed, bringing energy and engagement to each piece of content.

• Analyze and Optimize Performance: Track content performance metrics and share continuous optimization strategies to drive growth in engagements, reach, followers, etc.

• Trend-Savvy: Keep up to date with the latest trends and formats in short-form content to maintain relevance and audience appeal.

• Collaboration: Bring social-led ideas and continuously collaborate closely with the social media strategist and community manager on execution

What You Bring:

• Bachelor’s Degree preferred, not required.

• Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in content creation and/or social media management representing a brand or organization.

• Strong content creation skills that are distinctive and reflect the brand’s strategy and voice.

• Demonstrated ability to think creatively and have a strong understanding of culture.

• Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva Pro, InShot, CapCut, social media platforms – Instagram, TikTok and video editing knowledge required.

• Exceptional understanding of the social media landscape, including Instagram and TikTok.

• Ability to synthesize data to identify insights to inform creative content and opportunities.

• Exceptional communication (written and oral) skills.

• Experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously, self-direction, and collaborating successfully with multiple stakeholders and teams.

• A passion for food, and comfortable preparing frozen foods into content-ready meals.

Bonus Points:

• Experience using social listening and publishing tools.

• Previous experience working with large brands and partner agencies.

• Familiarity with paid social media content formats and performance metrics.

• Experience with food styling a plus.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Up to $41.00 per hour + Overtime

• Medical insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance

• 401(k)

• Disability insurance

title: Art Director — mobile 2D isometric strategy game (Chola dynasty, India)
desc: Hiring an Art Director for a mobile 2D isometric strategy game teaching Chola / Chozha dynasty history (c. 985-1070 CE) for ages 10-14. India-first launch, freemium, built on Defold. **Before the full spike we need test samples we can drop into our Defold build.** Shortlisted can…
full:
Hiring an Art Director for a mobile 2D isometric strategy game teaching Chola / Chozha dynasty history (c. 985-1070 CE) for ages 10-14. India-first launch, freemium, built on Defold.

**Before the full spike we need test samples we can drop into our Defold build.** Shortlisted candidates are paid a small fee to produce samples; the winning sample extends to a £1,500-£2,500 spike, and the spike extends to a 3-4 month full production contract (~500 sprites).

**Samples we need (approx. 1-2 days of work):**

1. One isometric building sprite — paddy field hut, tier 1, 256×192 px, PNG RGBA, transparent background, pivot bottom-centre.
2. One unit idle animation — spearman, 4 frames, 128×128 px each, PNG RGBA, pivot feet-centre.
3. One-paragraph style note explaining your technique choice (hand-drawn, 3D-rendered-to-2D, or hybrid) and one primary historical source you referenced (bronze, relief, or inscription).

**Visual direction (locked):** historically realistic, 2:1 isometric, period-accurate armour and buildings referenced from Chola bronzes and temple reliefs (Brihadisvara, Gangaikondacholisvarar). Not stylised, not chibi. Child-appropriate — no blood, no gore, no civilian battlefield characters, no sexualised armour, no caricature.

**Hard constraints:**
- Original work only. No reference from Clash of Clans / Lords Mobile / Rise of Kingdoms / Age of Empires Mobile.
- AI for moodboard only. **No AI-generated art ships.**
- Every delivered sprite must pass a historian review and a child-safety review.

One addition to the sample delivery. Because historical accuracy is a hard release gate on our side, we also need to see your working process alongside the final PNGs. **This applies equally to every shortlisted candidate.** Please include the following with the sample ZIP:

**1. Source file (your native format).**

Deliver the editable working file you used to produce the sprites. One of:

- **Blender:** `.blend` with the model, rig, lighting, and camera preserved. If you used a hybrid workflow with 2D touchup, include the touchup source too.
- **Photoshop:** `.psd` with **all layers preserved, unflattened**. Named layers preferred.
- **Procreate:** `.procreate` file (includes native time-lapse — good, keep it).
- **Krita / Clip Studio / Affinity Photo:** native format with layers preserved.

A flat 2-layer PSD at 2048×2048 downscaled is not a working file; it's an export. We need the real one.

**2. Short process recording.**

A **30-60 second screen recording** of any touchup pass on one frame — early sketch, cleanup, colour pass, shading — whichever moment best shows your workflow. Any of these is fine:

- Procreate time-lapse export (the built-in one is perfect — turn it on before you start)
- OBS / QuickTime / Loom screen capture while you work
- A short Instagram-reel-style over-the-shoulder phone recording of your iPad/tablet

Narration is welcome but not required. Upload unlisted to YouTube / Vimeo / Loom and send the link. Purpose: we want to see your decision-making process, not a polished presentation.

**3. 15-minute call with our historian.**

Once the sample ZIP arrives, we schedule a short **Google Meet or Zoom** with our historian reviewer. They'll ask you to walk through the primary source you cited — which specific bronze or temple relief, what you drew from it, what you changed and why. Comes with the territory because every shipped sprite will need historian sign-off; this is the first one. Please share **three 30-minute windows in your calendar over the next 7 working days** so we can match a slot.

**Why we ask:** our brief commits every shipped sprite to a named primary source (bronze, relief, inscription). Reviewing the working file, the process recording, and your source walkthrough together is how we verify the citation is real rather than retrofitted. It's standard for us; please flag now if any of the three is a problem on your end.

Everything else from the previous sample spec stands.

**In your bid, include:**
1. 2-3 portfolio links to shipped mobile 2D game art.
2. Your proposed technique and why.
3. Days to produce the sample set.
4. **One specific question you have about the direction after reading this post.** Bids without a specific question are not shortlisted.

Full art direction brief and technical pipeline doc shared with shortlisted candidates under NDA.

full:
Headquarters: Karnataka, India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app

Role - Video Editor 
 Work Location - Work From Home 
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. 
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: 

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) 
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) 
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
 Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) 
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) 
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) 
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) 
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more 

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.

 ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. 
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.

● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.

● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.

● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).

title: Genesis 9 Cuff Trim Morph Calibration
desc: Title: 3D Costume Artist: Modular Uniform Cuff Trim & Morph Calibration (Fan Art Project) Pipeline: Blender + Daz Studio 4.24 (Genesis 9) Upfront Verification (Required to Be Considered) To be considered for this project, you must include a screenshot from inside Daz Studio 4.24 …
full:
Title: 3D Costume Artist: Modular Uniform Cuff Trim & Morph Calibration (Fan Art Project)

Pipeline: Blender + Daz Studio 4.24 (Genesis 9)

Upfront Verification (Required to Be Considered)
To be considered for this project, you must include a screenshot from inside Daz Studio 4.24 with your proposal showing work relevant to this milestone—specifically a Genesis 9 clothing/accessory asset in the viewport with the Parameters pane (showing custom fitting/adjustment morph sliders), Scene pane (showing rigged Wearable Presets/Smoothing Modifier), or Morph Loader Pro visible. Proposals without a Daz Studio screenshot will not be considered.

Project Overview
Five sleeve rank trim assets (01–05) are already modeled, UV-mapped, textured for Iray, and rigged for Genesis 9, currently shaped to a straight cylindrical sleeve. My live dForce uniform dress has a subtle forearm taper and a slight flare at the hemmed cuff, causing the existing trims to clip into the fabric.

The goal of this project is to conform the resting geometry of all 5 trims to the live dress mesh and add clean, non-destructive fitting morphs in Daz Studio 4.24 so they sit cleanly during posing and dForce simulation.

Files Provided
Source .blend file containing the 5 rank trim variations.

Existing 5 Genesis 9 .duf Wearable Presets (01–05) along with their data folder and 4K PBR/Iray texture maps.

Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj — Reference export of the live dForce uniform dress (DAZ Studio 1 unit = 1cm scale) showing the exact forearm taper and cuff flare.

Scope of Work & Technical Requirements
Conform Resting Geometry to Live Dress Mesh

Reshape/conform the resting cuffs of all 5 rank trim variations in Blender to follow the exact forearm taper and cuff flare of Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj.

Leave a clean, even resting clearance over the sleeve surface with zero clipping.

Important: Preserve the crisp woven bullion thread thickness and silhouette—do not use a blanket inflation/Push deformation that bloats the individual cords.

Add Fitting Morph Sliders (via Morph Loader Pro)

Export morph targets from Blender (maintaining exact vertex order) and import them into Daz Studio 4.24 via Morph Loader Pro for all 5 presets, saved cleanly as morph assets in the data folder:

Expand Cuff (Radial) (Required): Expands the trim rings radially outward from the forearm axis by up to ~3–5 mm to clear dForce folds or different character forearm shapes, without inflating thread thickness or sliding the trim down the arm.

Slide Forearm (Up / Down) (Required): Shifts the trim cleanly up or down along the forearm axis (approx. ±1–1.5 cm) to accommodate minor sleeve pull during posing.

Flare Cuff (Recommended): Subtly flares the wrist-side edge outward relative to the upper edge to accommodate wider cuff draping during dForce simulations.

Daz Studio 4.24 Rigging, Smoothing & File Hygiene

Keep all existing Genesis 9 rigging, auto-follow compatibility, UV maps, and Iray materials intact.

Add a Smoothing Modifier to each trim (defaulting to low Smoothing Iterations 1–2 and moderate Collision Iterations 3–5, so it can track minor dress surface changes without softening the fine woven detail).

Maintain a clean, portable Daz content directory structure (data/ + Wearable Presets) with relative texture paths and no absolute local file paths.

Final Deliverables & Verification
5 updated .duf Wearable Presets (01–05) verified in Daz Studio 4.24 + updated data folder (including the new morph .dsf files).

Updated source .blend file containing the conformed resting meshes and shape keys.

Verification screenshots from Daz Studio 4.24 showing:

Zero clipping against Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj in resting A-pose.

Clean deformation with the Genesis 9 elbow bent (~45°–90°).

The new Expand Cuff and Slide Forearm morph sliders visible in the Parameters pane and functioning cleanly.

full:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to help us find and onboard small businesses onto **LokalNeeds**.

Website: https://lokalneeds.in

LokalNeeds helps businesses create their own direct ordering link without needing a separate website.

Example: https://lokalneeds.in/your-business-name

Businesses can manage products, receive customer orders, offer pickup or delivery, and manage deliveries using our platform.

**Our goal is to acquire real businesses that actively use LokalNeeds, not just increase social media followers or engagement.**

## Responsibilities

1. Find small businesses, restaurants, home kitchens, bakeries, and WhatsApp sellers through Instagram and Facebook.
2. Identify businesses that don't have their own online ordering websites.
3. Contact business owners through Instagram DMs, Facebook, WhatsApp, or phone.
4. Explain how LokalNeeds works and its benefits.
5. Encourage interested businesses to register for a free business link.
6. Assist businesses with onboarding, adding products, and setting up their ordering pages.
7. Follow up with businesses to encourage actual usage.
8. Maintain a Google Sheet tracking leads, conversations, registrations, and active shops.

## Initial Pilot

We want to start with a small pilot to evaluate results.

**Target:**
- Identify and contact 50–100 relevant businesses.
- Generate genuine interested leads.
- Onboard 5–10 real businesses.
- Help businesses activate their ordering links.

These are pilot targets, not guaranteed outcomes.

## Budget

₹3,000–₹5,000 for the initial pilot.

We are open to discussing performance-based incentives for successfully onboarded and activated businesses.

Long-term opportunities are available based on results.

## Preferred Skills

- Social Media Lead Generation
- Instagram & Facebook Outreach
- Business Development
- Sales and Marketing
- Merchant / Restaurant Onboarding
- WhatsApp Marketing
- Hindi or regional Indian language communication

## Important

We are NOT looking for someone who only creates social media posts, reels, or graphics.

We need someone who can directly approach business owners, generate qualified leads, and help them start using LokalNeeds.

## When Applying

Please answer:

1. Have you previously onboarded restaurants, shops, or small businesses onto a digital platform?
2. How would you find businesses that don't have an online ordering website?
3. Can you directly contact business owners and help them register?
4. How many businesses can you realistically onboard during a 7–14 day pilot?
5. What is your proposed pilot cost?

Please share examples of similar work if available.

BID PRICE ONLY ACCEPTED - IF WE TALK AND YOU TELL ME YOUR BID WAS PRICED WRONG I WILL NOT WORK WITH YOU.
Hi! I’m looking for an AI video creator to produce one 3-minute-30-second YouTube episode for Cooking Marcy**, my cooking series hosted by a playful brick-style girl chef. I’ll provide the complete script and Marcy’s character reference.

Please match the reference closely and keep Marcy’s appearance consistent throughout. Build a kitchen, props, and plated dish in the same realistic LEGO-style brick aesthetic. Animate Marcy with natural gestures, blinking, facial expressions, and lip movements synced to an energetic, playful female AI voice.

Marcy introduces herself, reveals the finished dish, and walks viewers through the recipe using the supplied script. Keep Marcy and the plated dish at the center of the episode, and use close-ups and clear, numbered on-screen graphics to illustrate each step as she explains it. There’s no need to animate every cooking action. End with Marcy’s signature line, **“See you next whisk!”**

Deliverables

- One upload-ready 16:9 MP4 in 4K or the highest HD resolution you can deliver
- A final runtime of 3:25–3:35, aiming for 3:30

# Cooking Marcy and Grandma’s Secret Cookbook
### Blueberry & Nutella Toast · 3:30

Marcy sings to open the cookbook, then follows Grandma’s three recipe steps. Keep the finished toast beside her while she explains each step, with close-ups when she points out a detail.

### 0:00–0:40 · Grandma’s secret cookbook

*[Marcy pulls a cookbook from under a pile of tea towels. A little gold lock holds it shut.]*

**MARCY:** “Look what I found! Grandma’s secret cookbook. I used to watch her make breakfast, but I never knew where she kept her recipes. There’s a note tucked under the lock. Let’s see what it says. ‘Sing your favourite fruit three times, and the book will open.’ Well, that’s easy. My favourite fruit is blueberry. Ready?”

**MARCY, singing:** “Blueberry… blueberry… blueberry!”

*[She sings the last one a little higher. The lock clicks open.]*

**MARCY:** “It worked! Let’s see what Grandma picked for us today.”

### 0:40–1:10 · Today’s recipe

*[The page reads “Blueberry & Nutella Toast.” Marcy slides the finished toast into view.]*

**MARCY:** “Blueberry and Nutella toast! This looks just like the toast Grandma used to make me. See the golden edges, the chocolatey middle, and all those blueberries on top? To make one slice, you’ll need a slice of bread, a spoonful of Nutella, and a small handful of blueberries. Wash your blueberries and pat them dry so they’re ready to go.”

### 1:10–1:50 · Step 1 — Toast the bread

*[Show the first recipe card, then cut close to the golden edge of the finished toast.]*

**MARCY:** “First, ask a grown-up to toast your bread until it’s golden. Grandma always showed me how to check the colour. She’d say, ‘Look for the colour of a biscuit.’ See it right here, along the edge? That’s the bit that goes crunch. Let the toast cool for a moment before you spread anything on it. While we wait, can you make your best toast crunch?”

*[Pause for kids to join in.]*

**MARCY:** “Crunch! Okay, our toast is ready.”

### 1:50–2:30 · Step 2 — Spread the Nutella

*[A simple overhead graphic shows a spoonful of Nutella in the middle of a slice of toast.]*

**MARCY:** “Put a spoonful of Nutella in the middle. Use the back of your spoon to spread it out towards the edges. Grandma showed me how to do it in circles. Start with a little circle in the middle, then make it bigger as you go. Try drawing one in the air with me. Little circle… bigger circle… all the way around. I leave a tiny border of toast showing. That way, I’ve got a little spot to hold when I pick it up.”

### 2:30–3:10 · Step 3 — Add the blueberries

*[Cut back to the finished toast. The camera moves closer so kids can see where Marcy placed the berries.]*

**MARCY:** “Now for my favourite part. Place your blueberries right on top of the Nutella. I like to put a few down the middle first, then fill in the spaces on each side. Can you spot a place where one more blueberry would fit?”

*[Pause. Marcy points to an open spot near the corner and adds one berry.]*

**MARCY:** “There! Press each berry in just a little so it stays put when you pick up your toast. You can make a row like mine or put blueberries all over. And that’s Grandma’s blueberry and Nutella toast, ready to eat!”

### 3:10–3:30 · The first bite

*[Marcy takes a bite. Leave a beat for the crunch.]*

**MARCY:** “Mmm. Crunchy toast, chocolatey Nutella, and a juicy blueberry in the same bite. I’m saving this page so we can make it again. Bye, little chefs. **See you next whisk!**”

Marcy tucks a ribbon into the recipe page and waves. Hold on Marcy and the toast through 3:30.

title: Isometric 2D Vineyard Tile Set
desc: Project: "Der Weingärtner" (working title) – a vineyard management sim (WISIM) for PC/Steam, built in Godot 4 by a solo developer. Setting: A fictional wine village on the Neckar river in southern Germany, starting in 1985. The player runs a small family vineyard: pruning, tying,…
full:
Project: "Der Weingärtner" (working title) – a vineyard management sim (WISIM) for PC/Steam, built in Godot 4 by a solo developer.

Setting: A fictional wine village on the Neckar river in southern Germany, starting in 1985. The player runs a small family vineyard: pruning, tying, spraying, harvesting, selling grapes to the cooperative. The map shows the village, the farm, and the vineyard plots as isometric tiles. The look should be clean, colorful, and slightly retro – friendly and readable, not photorealistic.

WHAT I NEED (INITIAL PAID SET)
Vineyard ground tiles in three terrain types, each in four seasons:
1. Flat vineyard (rows on level ground)
2. Slope vineyard (rows running down a hillside)
3. Steep terrace vineyard (narrow terraces held by dry-stone walls, with small stone stairs between them – typical for the Neckar valley)

Seasons for each terrain type:
- Winter: bare, pruned vines, brown wood, canes bent onto the wire, bare or frosted ground
- Spring: first light-green shoots, buds breaking, some grass between rows
- Summer: full green canopy, small green grape clusters
- Autumn: yellow/orange leaves, ripe dark-blue grape clusters

= 12 tiles in total. If the price is too high, start with the slope vineyard in all four seasons (4 tiles) as a test.

PERIOD DETAILS (IMPORTANT)
The game is set in 1985 in a German wine region, so please avoid the modern / American vineyard look:
- Wooden posts (weathered, grey-brown) with wire trellis – no white metal or concrete posts
- No fences around the plots; borders are a narrow dirt/grass path, a low stone wall or simply the next plot
- Rows close together (narrow-track tractors fit between them)
- Grass strips between the rows are fine but no modern drip irrigation

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Isometric projection 2:1 (e.g., 128×64 px base diamond; vines and posts may extend above, so canvas e.g., 128×128). Open to your suggestion for the best size – please tell me what you'd recommend.
- Tiles must connect seamlessly to neighboring tiles of the same type (rows continue across tile borders).
- Rows always run in the same direction on all tiles.
- Consistent light direction (top-left) and a consistent limited palette across all seasons so they can be swapped without the map "jumping."
- Must stay readable when zoomed out: The player should recognize the season and terrain type at a glance.
- Transparent PNG exports + layered source files (PSD, Krita or Aseprite).
- Please keep posts/wires, vines, grapes and ground on separate layers. Later I want to show states such as "posts broken," "harvested" or "overgrown" by changing single layers.

LICENSE
- Full commercial rights for use in the game trailers store page and marketing.
- Exclusive: The tiles must not be resold as stock assets.
- Credit in-game credits is of course offered.
- Hand-made art only please (no AI-generated images) – required for Steam store disclosure.

POSSIBLE FOLLOW-UP WORK
If the test goes well there will be more work over months:
1. Additional vineyard states like harvested damaged posts frost damage overgrown neglected newly planted.
2. Farm and village buildings like farmhouse barn wine cellar town hall cooperative church etc.
3. Small characters vehicles like grape pickers narrow vineyard tractor trailer etc.
4. Character portraits for family members event messages UI icons tools diesel wire posts grapes money etc.

**Title: Social Media Templates, Loyalty Card & Promotional Materials for SecondShift**

### About the Business
SecondShift is a student-focused second-hand marketplace based in Athlone, Ireland. The business allows students and locals to buy, sell and reuse second-hand items such as clothing, textbooks, electronics, furniture and other everyday essentials.

Our tagline is **“Buy. Sell. Reuse.”**

We are looking for a creative freelancer to help establish a consistent, modern brand identity across our social media platforms and physical promotional materials.

### Project Requirements

We require a design package consisting of:

- **12 social media templates** for Instagram posts, Instagram Stories and TikTok covers.
- **1 loyalty card design**, front and back, incorporating our rewards system.
- **1 A3 promotional poster** for advertising SecondShift around college and locally.
- All designs must be consistent with our existing brand identity and suitable for a student audience.

### Design Style
We want a clean, modern, recognisable and professional design that appeals primarily to college students and young adults.

Our brand colours are:
- Green: `#70992e`
- Black: `#111111`
- White: `#FFFFFF`

The designs should feel fresh, eye-catching and easy to recognise when scrolling through social media. They should not look overly corporate or cluttered.

### Social Media Templates
The 12 templates should be editable and suitable for different types of content, including:

- Promoting products for sale.
- Advertising new listings.
- Buy and sell promotions.
- Student discounts and loyalty rewards.
- Second-hand shopping and sustainability.
- Freshers' week promotions.
- Move-out and end-of-year clear-out campaigns.
- General brand awareness and promotional posts.

The templates should be reusable, allowing us to easily change photos, text, prices and product information without needing a designer every time.

### Loyalty Card
Design a physical loyalty card that reflects the SecondShift brand and rewards customers for using the marketplace. Include details about earning points through both buying and selling items on the platform. Highlight how these points can be redeemed for discounts or other rewards to encourage engagement with the system.

The card should be attractive, easy to understand and practical to print. It should reflect our loyalty scheme clearly while maintaining consistency with our branding guidelines.

### Promotional Poster
Design an A3 poster suitable for display around TUS Athlone, student accommodation and other local locations. 
The poster should clearly communicate:
- What SecondShift is.
- What customers can buy and sell.
- Our tagline: Buy. Sell. Reuse.
- Why students should use the platform.
- A clear call to action encouraging people to join.
Include any style references or examples of similar posters you admire that align with your vision for this project. 
### Deliverables  - 12 editable social media templates.- Loyalty card design (front/back). - A3 poster design.- Editable source files (Canva/Figma preferred).- Final exports in high-resolution PNG/PDF formats.- Print-ready files for loyalty card/poster.- One round of revisions included.- Freelancers are encouraged to submit mockups or samples showcasing their approach.

Project Type: Freelance / Contract 
Experience Level: Intermediate to Expert 
Engagement: Project-Based (Potential for Long-Term Collaboration)

 Project Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced UX/UI Designer to help us design a modern, intuitive, and visually appealing marketplace platform.

Our goal is to build a user-friendly digital marketplace that provides a seamless experience for buyers and sellers. We need a designer who can transform business requirements into clean, professional, and engaging user interfaces while ensuring excellent usability across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

 Key Responsibilities

- Design modern, intuitive, and visually appealing UI/UX for our marketplace platform.
- Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
- Design essential marketplace features, including:
 - User registration and login.
 - Buyer and seller dashboards.
 - Product/service listing and management.
 - Search, filtering, and navigation.
 - Product/service detail pages.
 - Shopping cart and checkout experience.
 - User profiles and account settings.
 - Order management and transaction history.
- Develop a consistent design system, including typography, colors, buttons, and reusable components.
- Ensure responsive designs for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

full:
Project Brief: Bilingual Editorial Website & Online Shop

**Overview**
I am looking to bring my floral and creative studio online with a bilingual (**English / Spanish**) website that feels like an art-directed digital publication rather than a standard agency template. The experience should be pared-back, photography-driven, and luxuriously spacious—defined by generous negative space, expressive typographic hierarchies, and fluid transitions that let our botanical work breathe.

**Visual & Aesthetic Reference**
For layout pacing, typography, and minimalist restraint, see: `[https://tulipstudio.hr/en](https://tulipstudio.hr/en)`

**Core Objective**
To present our studio, bespoke floral services, and curated shop with quiet confidence and clarity. Visitors should seamlessly switch between English and Spanish and move effortlessly from our brand story into our services, online shop, press features, and inquiry flow.

**Site Architecture & Navigation**

* **Global Header:** Minimalist navigation bar featuring our logo, an **EN / ES language switcher**, and the exact 5 main menu items:
1. **Shop** *(Tienda)* – Streamlined e-commerce storefront to purchase physical floral goods/objects directly (with cart, checkout, and shipping), plus a short inquiry form for bespoke/custom orders.
2. **Services** *(Servicios)* – Editorial presentation of our signature offerings (e.g., *The Flower Bar – Interactive Floral Experiences for Celebrations*), structured with refined copy, process notes, high-res photography, and a direct booking/inquiry trigger.
3. **Contact** *(Contacto)* – Streamlined inquiry form for events and custom requests, alongside direct contact details, location, and social links.
4. **Studio** *(Estudio)* – Our brand narrative, creative philosophy, and behind-the-scenes/team imagery.
5. **Publicity** *(Publicidad)* – Clean editorial archive of press clippings, interviews, and media features.

*(Note: The **Home** page should act as an editorial entry point introducing the brand statement, full-bleed hero imagery, and curated previews leading into Services, Shop, and Studio.)*

**Design & Interaction Requirements**

* **Editorial Layout:** Full-bleed photography, sharp edges (no rounded corners or heavy drop shadows), asymmetric grids, and strong contrast between large editorial serif headings and crisp, understated sans-serif body copy.
* **Color Palette:** Warm, restrained minimalism (off-white/cream grounds, soft charcoal typography, and subtle brand accents) that gives every visual element breathing room.

I am platform-agnostic, provided the backend is intuitive enough for non-technical team members to manage **both English and Spanish content**, swap imagery, publish press features, and handle shop inventory/orders (e.g., Webflow + Localization & E-commerce, Framer, Craft CMS, or a custom headless setup like Next.js/Astro + Sanity/Shopify). Clean, modular, and well-documented code is a must.

2. Configured CMS & E-commerce backend, accompanied by a short Loom walkthrough for day-to-day content and order management.
3. Digital style guide documenting typography scales, color tokens, and component spacing rules.
4. Complete handover package: source files/repository, custom code snippets, and animation/transition documentation.

**How to Apply**
Please share **1–2 live links** that demonstrate your ability to balance strict minimalism with fluid, tactile motion, along with your **recommended tech stack** (specifically addressing bilingual + e-commerce handling), **estimated timeline**, and **ballpark investment**. If this aesthetic and scope resonate with you, let’s create something timeless.

title: Automated Tile-to-Stair Visualization Pipeline
desc: AI pipeline: apply a tile from a raw photo onto existing stair images using masks (no 3D rendering) We make stairs clad with porcelain/ceramic tiles. We have about 42 stair images (different designs and angles). We do NOT want to render the tile in Blender. We need an AI pipeline…
full:
AI pipeline: apply a tile from a raw photo onto existing stair images using masks (no 3D rendering)
We make stairs clad with porcelain/ceramic tiles. We have about 42 stair images (different designs and angles). We do NOT want to render the tile in Blender. We need an AI pipeline that puts the tile onto our existing stair images, using masks.
Input:
A raw, real-life tile photo. It is not cropped or scanned: shot at an angle, uneven light, reflections, background, low resolution.
Base stair images (~42), plus masks for each surface: treads, risers and nosings/edges. If needed, we can also export extra passes from Blender: UV, depth, normal, object/material ID.
What the AI must do:
Extract the tile from the photo: find it, fix the perspective, crop it, and remove glare, shadows and noise.
Recreate the tile in high quality while keeping it identical to the original: same pattern, veining, structure and colour distribution. No reinterpretation.
Apply the tile inside the masks with correct perspective, real-world scale (e.g. 60×120 cm), realistic tile layout and grout lines, and correct cuts on treads, risers and nosings.
Keep the stair geometry, edges, lighting, shadows and reflections of the base image. The result must look like a real photo of the stairs.
Process all ~42 images automatically for each new tile.
Key requirement:
The tile face must be exactly the same across all ~42 images. It's the same tile, not 42 variations. The pattern must not change or drift between images. Colour can be fine-tuned on our side; the tile face is the priority.
Deliverables:
A working tool I can run myself: ComfyUI workflow or Python script, local or API-based. Input = tile photo; output = 42 finished images.
Documentation and a handover session.
Acceptance test on 5 of our real tile photos.
Ideal candidate:
Strong ComfyUI / Stable Diffusion / Flux experience: ControlNet, IP-Adapter, inpainting, relighting, upscaling
Texture projection/warping onto masked surfaces using UV or depth
Portfolio showing AI that preserves product details (product placement, material swaps, interior visualization)
In your proposal, please include:
Your approach: how will you keep the tile pattern identical across all images and avoid AI hallucination?
Relevant examples (material swap / product-preserving work)
Timeline, budget and hardware requirements
