title: Blender Character — Near-Infrared (NIR) Skin, Eyes & Modular Accessories for Synthetic Face Dataset -- 2
desc: OVERVIEW We are building a synthetic human face dataset in Blender using the open-source Google GNM parametric head extension: https://www.reddit.com/r/blender/comments/1uzaxc3/google_gnm_open_source_parametric_head_released/ Please note: We will not be sending pre-made .blend fi…
full:
OVERVIEW
We are building a synthetic human face dataset in Blender using the open-source Google GNM parametric head extension:
https://www.reddit.com/r/blender/comments/1uzaxc3/google_gnm_open_source_parametric_head_released/

Please note: We will not be sending pre-made .blend files upfront. You can download and install the free Google GNM Blender extension directly and build all materials, eye shaders, hair, and accessories around the standard GNM head setup. Everything you deliver must plug cleanly and easily into our existing Google GNM Blender workflow.

Our goal is to use an automated Python rendering pipeline to randomize face shapes, skin profiles, hairstyles, facial hair, glasses, and headwear—generating diverse synthetic human portraits (similar in variety and framing to Microsoft’s FaceSynthetics dataset: https://github.com/microsoft/FaceSynthetics/blob/main/docs/img/dataset_samples.jpg), rendered to match real Near-Infrared (NIR) camera imagery.

Target IR Output & Eyeball References:
- Sample IR Face Output: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11263-021-01432-4
- High-Resolution NIR Eye & Iris Reference: https://www.researchgate.net/figure/High-resolution-NIR-face-images-and-corresponding-face-and-iris-images-a-High_fig1_221383633

(These links—along with additional sample IR images we will share with you—serve as our visual target. We will iterate together on your initial sample renders to fine-tune the look so it closely matches our actual camera output.)

We are looking for an experienced Blender look-dev / character artist to deliver:
1. An IR-accurate skin, eye, and mouth material library tailored to the Google GNM head.
2. A modular library of hair and accessories that fit cleanly across Google GNM head variations.
3. A calibrated lighting/render setup inside Blender that reproduces real NIR image characteristics.

------------------------------------------------------------

1. IR-ACCURATE SKIN, EYE & MOUTH MATERIAL LIBRARY
- IR Skin Tones & Ages: Distinct skin profiles covering very fair to very deep tones (referencing the Monk Skin Tone Scale) plus age variations (smoother skin for younger faces, fine lines/pores/sunspots for older faces), calibrated specifically for how melanin, subsurface scattering, and skin reflectance behave in monochrome Near-Infrared imagery.
- Close-Up Detail & Visible Skin Marks: High-resolution (2K minimum) PBR textures that hold up in tight portrait close-ups—ensuring pores, fine lines, and natural skin marks (moles, freckles, blemishes, scars, and light stubble shadow) remain clearly and accurately visible under IR illumination, with zero seams or stretching on the GNM head mesh.
- Script-Friendly Master Shader: A single master skin shader with clearly exposed, easy-to-script controls for skin tone/IR reflectance, roughness/shine, subsurface scattering, freckle/mole/blemish intensity, and stubble shadow, alongside pre-configured presets for all profiles.
- IR Eyeball & Iris Physics (Priority):
 * Eyeballs must accurately replicate real Near-Infrared optical behavior (matching the NIR eye reference link above):
 - Deep black pupil with a sharp white glint/dot (corneal specular reflection) when looking toward the camera.
 - Clearly defined grey iris with realistic iris pattern/texture and natural IR reflectance across different iris shades.
 - Bright white sclera with realistic wetness and a subtle tear line.
 * Natural IR-tuned materials for lips, eyebrows, eyelashes, and interior mouth parts (teeth, gums, tongue) on the GNM mesh.

------------------------------------------------------------

2. MODULAR ACCESSORY LIBRARY (COMPATIBLE WITH GOOGLE GNM HEADS)
We need a comprehensive library of modular, mix-and-match assets built at real-world scale with clean topology and PBR materials, designed to maximize visual variety and generate a wide range of unique synthetic combinations:
- Head Hair & Eyebrows: A wide variety of hairstyles (short, medium, long, straight, wavy, curly, coily, tied back, shaved/buzz, etc.) plus diverse eyebrow shapes and densities in multiple natural shades (including grey and white).
- Facial Hair: A broad selection of styles (light and heavy stubble, short beards, full beards, moustaches, goatees, sideburns, etc.) across multiple shades.
- Eyewear: A diverse collection of prescription glasses (thin metal, thick acetate, rimless, half-rim) with clear refractive lenses, alongside sunglasses (aviator, square, round, wrap-around, oversized) with tinted, gradient, and mirrored lenses that behave realistically in IR.
- Headwear & Face Coverings: A wide assortment of headwear options (caps, beanies, wide-brim hats, headscarves, turbans, hoods, etc.) plus various surgical and cloth face masks.

GNM Compatibility & Automation Requirements:
- Parametric Fit: Because Google GNM generates varying face shapes, head sizes, and expressions, accessories must adapt/fit cleanly to generated GNM heads with zero clipping or floating gaps (e.g., bound via surface/mesh deformers or rig/shape-key compatible setups so they follow head shape changes automatically).
- Clean Layering: Accessories must combine together (for example, wearing glasses, a cap, and a beard simultaneously) without intersecting each other.
- Automation-Ready Structure: Because we will randomize combinations via a Python script, all objects, collections, materials, and shader parameters must follow a strict, consistent naming convention and clean hierarchy.

------------------------------------------------------------

TECHNICAL & LICENSING REQUIREMENTS
- Built and tested in Blender (Cycles) using native Blender tools and the free Google GNM extension—no paid add-ons required to open or render.
- Textures saved with relative paths or packed cleanly into the .blend files.
- Usage Rights: All work must be original or properly licensed so we have unrestricted rights to use the 3D assets internally to generate and use synthetic 2D image datasets commercially.

Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia

URL: http://capslock.global

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview 

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.
You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.
If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management
• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up
• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control
• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation
• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI
• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration
• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time
 Must-Have Skills
• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills
• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
• Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
• Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills
• Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
• Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
• Clear, professional communicator
• Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
• Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

• Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
• Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
• Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
• Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
• Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
• Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
• Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

full:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States

URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do
• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for
• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure
• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)
• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

Job Overview
Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.

About us
Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.
We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.
We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.

What you'll do
• Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
• Write video scripts and outlines.
• Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
• Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.

What we're looking for
• Native-level written and spoken English
• Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
• Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
• Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
• AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
• High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
• Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
• Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
• Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
• A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
• Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
• Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada

Nice to have
• Previous experience creating educational video content
• Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about

full:
Headquarters: Flower Mound, TX, USA

URL: http://www.hadleydesigns.com

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

• Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.

• Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.

• Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.

We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.

What You'll Own

• End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory

• Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop

• Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas

• Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog

• How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format

• Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price

• Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit

• AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog

• Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

• Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape

• Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results

• Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion

• Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver

Requirements

Who You Are

• 3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business

• A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data

• You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer

• You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format

• You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price

• Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising

• AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward

• Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done

• Clear, confident spoken and written English

• Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

Benefits

Why You'll Thrive Here

• Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale

• Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins

• Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule

• Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO

• Personal development and autonomy over your time

• An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard

desc: Headquarters: URL: http://www.thrivemarket.com ABOUT THRIVE MARKET Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustaina…
full:
Headquarters: 

URL: http://www.thrivemarket.com

ABOUT THRIVE MARKET 

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

A contractor (30-40 hrs per week) who helps keep the paid social performance creative engine running: first-round ad review, QA and delivery, performance data, builds and decks, and ad hoc support for our creative strategist.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. First-round creative review

• Review ads against the brief: does the concept, message, and offer answer what was asked?

• Assess engagement potential (hook, first 3 seconds, clarity of CTA, platform-native feel)

• Give team concise first-round feedback and flag what needs a closer look before it goes further

2. Creative QA & delivery

• Check aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, etc.) and file specs (format, size, video length, safe zones, captions)

• Check ad naming against convention

• Confirm all assets are in (nothing missing) and the correct, approved version is used

• Deliver to channel managers with a standard handoff note (batch contents, launch date, links)

3. Coordination & Workload Balance

•  Keep track of what is due, what is ready, and what is at risk in Wrike and build out a 8-12 week rolling calendar

•  Balance competing projects and flag blockers or slipping deadlines early

•  Proactively contact the right people when a new project starts (designers, editors, copywriters, channel managers, brand/legal)

•  Move work along on Sabrina's behalf (follow-ups, nudges), with signoff as described below

4. Ad hoc support

•  Slot in last-minute asks and triage them by urgency, telling Sabrina what gets bumped

•  Own small edit and resize requests end to end without Sabrina stepping in: no editing skills required, but coordinate with the project manager to find bandwidth on the editing team, brief the editor, and track the request through delivery

5. Performance data & reporting

•  Pull performance data (Motion, Meta Ads Manager) and build recurring reports (top and bottom performers, spend by concept)

•  Tag and categorize creatives (hook, format, angle, offer)

•  Keep a testing learnings log

•  Surface early takeaways to inform briefs and next rounds

6. Decks & strategy support

•  Help build decks: test readouts, performance recaps, creative reviews

•  Research competitor and inspiration ads

•  Draft first-pass briefs or test summaries for Sabrina to review

QUALIFICATIONS

Core competencies

• Proactive mindset; balances strategic objectives with day-to-day tactical execution  

• Maintains timelines and prioritizes tasks for smooth workflows and timely delivery of creative assets  

• Comfortable wearing multiple hats and shifting between review, data, and coordination work

Must-have

• Background in performance creative (paid social preferred), with a trained eye for what makes ads engaging and on-brief

• Strong attention to detail (specs, naming, completeness)

• Clear written communication, able to give concise, constructive feedback

• Organized and self-directed; comfortable with fast-changing priorities

• Basic data pulling and deck-building skills

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.

Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer

At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. We’re proud to be an inclusive company and an Equal Opportunity Employer and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Overview

We are looking for a driven and passionate Marketing Designer to join our creative team at our agency. In this role, you will be responsible for designing high-quality, visually appealing digital assets and campaigns for a variety of clients. Your designs will be used across a range of platforms, including compelling static and animated social ads, marketing emails, and landing pages for a variety of exciting brands.

You are a creative powerhouse with a deep understanding of digital platforms, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to push boundaries while meeting client objectives. As a Marketing Designer, you will take ownership of your work—from concept to execution—and collaborate closely with strategy, content, and digital teams to bring bold, effective ideas to life.

About Anchour

Anchour is a creative agency of 38 and growing, focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight. Headquartered in Maine, we specialize in serving SMBs and startups across industries like consumer goods, home services, financial services, retail, and professional services.

As a full-service agency, we offer strategy, branding, website design, development, copywriting, and performance marketing solutions. At Anchour, we believe in cultivating an inclusive environment where creativity, curiosity, and collaboration thrive.

What You’ll Do

Create Scroll-Stopping Ads: Develop innovative and high-performing static and animated Meta ads that captivate audiences and drive conversions, using tools like Figma, CapCut, Canva, and After Effects.

Ideate & Conceptualize: Collaborate with strategists and marketers to brainstorm and execute fresh, bold creative ideas for ads and campaigns that stand out in crowded digital spaces.

Craft Engaging Emails: Design visually compelling email templates and campaigns, ensuring they align with best practices for performance and user engagement.

Support Multi-Channel Campaigns: Design assets for additional platforms like Google Display and landing pages, ensuring consistency and alignment with brand guidelines.

Keep Creative Fresh: Regularly refresh and optimize high-performing creative based on campaign performance data, ensuring ads and emails remain relevant and effective.

Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to align creative direction with campaign goals and audience needs.

Bring Motion to Life: Add animation and motion to ads and creative assets, leveraging tools like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and After Effects to bring dynamic ideas to life.

Experiment & Innovate: Test new concepts, visual styles, and creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences and drives results.

Present & Refine Designs: Confidently share your creative work with clients, articulate your thinking, and incorporate feedback to deliver polished final assets.

Manage Your Workflow: Stay organized and manage your time effectively to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with design and platform trends, exploring new creative ideas that elevate our work and push boundaries.

What We’d Like To See

• Proven Expertise: 3+ years of experience in a design role focused on Meta ads, email marketing, or performance-driven campaigns, preferably in an agency or for high-performing brands.

• Figma Mastery: Extensive experience designing in Figma, including creating templates, prototypes, and layouts for both ads and emails.

• CapCut Proficiency: Familiarity with CapCut to create and refine light animations for Meta ads and short-form digital content.

• Strong Adobe Skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for secondary design tasks.

• Email Expertise: A strong understanding of email marketing best practices, responsive design principles, and user-centric layouts.

• Meta Advertising Know-How: Deep familiarity with Meta ad formats, specs, and design best practices for performance marketing.

• Portfolio of Results-Driven Work: A portfolio showcasing your ability to create engaging digital designs that meet campaign objectives and drive results.

• Detail-Oriented & Strategic: A keen eye for detail, typography, composition, and hierarchy, paired with the ability to think strategically about design’s role in achieving performance goals.

• Adaptable & Curious: A growth-oriented mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, trends, and techniques.

• Team Player: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, working seamlessly with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to bring ideas to life.

What You’ll Get

• Competitive Salary.

• Work remotely. Live and work wherever you like.

• Retirement. Savings plan with a 4% company match.

• Premium Insurance. Premium health, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.

• Optional HSA. An optional health savings account (HSA) for employees to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.

• Home Office Setup. Get a laptop + 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.

• Paid & Flexible Holidays. 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.

• Paid Time Off. Minimum three weeks of paid time off per year.

• Paid Leaves. Paid parental, medical, bereavement, and other types of leave.

• Flexible & Summer Fridays. Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.

• Lifelong Learners Fund. Cash for professional development (books, conferences, courses), and team bonding fun times.

• Baby Bonding Bucks. $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals, or other baby-related expenses for any employee welcoming a new child

full:
About us
At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role
Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities
• Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

• Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

• Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

• Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

• Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

• Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

• Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

• Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

• Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

• Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

• Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

• Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background
You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
• A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

• Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

• Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

• A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

• A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

• Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦
• Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

• Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

• Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

• Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

• Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures
We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:
• Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

• Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

• Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

ACE Stainless Supply distributes stainless steel pipe, valves, fittings, bar, and sheet, serving customers through our Santa Ana, California, and Caldwell, Idaho, operations. We are expanding our digital business with AceCarbonSteel.com, and we want someone who can help build it, launch it, and grow it.

You will report to Erica Biscocho, Director of E-Commerce and Digital Operations. You will work alongside Hafsa in e-commerce and our marketing team, coordinate product information with Funmi, and partner with sales and our technical providers. This is a hands-on role: you will create content, make website improvements, run campaigns, and move launch work through to completion.

Your first major deliverable

Launch design of AceCarbonSteel.com as an operational customer-facing website on January 1, 2027.

Our clean product data is ready. Your work is to transfer it accurately, propose the branding and design, build the shopping experience with the team, and prove that customers can use it successfully. You must bring practical website implementation experience as well as marketing skills.

The January 1 launch takes priority within your first 90 days. Our accelerated launch milestones are:

By November 20, 2026 — Present branding and design proposals for Erica’s approval: visual direction, homepage, category and product page concepts, navigation, mobile layouts, and a dated implementation plan with owners and dependencies.

By December 15, 2026 — Complete the approved design and catalog migration in staging. Configure search, filters, product pages, quote and purchase paths, and measurement tools with the appropriate team members.

By December 30, 2026 — Complete testing and corrections. Submit a documented launch checklist, test results, and outstanding issues for Erica’s go-live approval.

January 1, 2027 — Launch the approved site with working customer journeys, verified inquiry and order routing, and a launch campaign ready to run.

Through the remainder of your first 90 days, monitor the live site, resolve issues, and use actual customer behavior and sales results to prioritize improvements.

What launch ready means

You will own the launch checklist and coordinate technical dependencies early. Before release, the team must verify:

Catalog accuracy: reconcile source and destination record counts; validate product identifiers, descriptions, sizes, materials, units of measure, weights, categories, and approved pricing. Resolve discrepancies with Funmi before publishing.

Customer experience: test navigation, product search and filters, mobile layouts, images, downloads, account access where applicable, and clear paths to request a quote or place an order.

Transactions and handoffs: test quote forms and notifications; validate applicable cart, checkout, payment, tax, freight, and order-confirmation flows with the responsible providers. Confirm that inquiries and orders reach the right Ace team.

Search and measurement: verify page titles, metadata, crawl and indexing settings, sitemap, redirects where needed, and analytics events for product views, inquiries, and purchases. Confirm that staging restrictions are removed at launch.

Operations: document how the team maintains the site, manages incoming inquiries and orders, and reports defects. Complete Erica’s final review before going live.

What you will own after launch

SEO and website conversion

Build keyword and competitor research around how contractors, fabricators, and purchasing teams actually search. Improve category pages, product pages, metadata, internal links, and useful educational content. Use Google Search Console to identify indexing and search issues; use GA4 to find where customers abandon inquiry or purchase paths. Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and complete approved changes.

Social media and content

Own a practical publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Create product features, application explainers, branch updates, customer stories with permission, and promotional content. Produce two YouTube videos per month and repurpose them into shorter clips and posts. Coordinate original footage with branch staff and verify technical claims with the product team.

Email and sales support

Build and execute two Mailchimp campaigns each week, on Monday and Thursday. Segment audiences, maintain contact lists, test links and mobile layouts, and direct customers to relevant products or quote forms. Keep line cards, branch marketing materials, and website promotions current. Work with sales to connect campaign inquiries to follow-up and results.

Brand consistency and execution

Keep messaging, visuals, product information, and calls to action consistent across websites, email, and social channels. Bring concepts and recommendations to Erica, obtain required approvals, and carry approved work through publication. Maintain a shared task board with deadlines, owners, blockers, and next actions.

How we will measure success

Send a concise performance report every Monday by 10:00 AM Pacific Time. Show what changed, what it produced, and what you will do next. Establish baselines and agree on numeric growth targets with Erica during onboarding.

desc: Headquarters: Remote URL: http://convertibles.dev About us Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecomme…
full:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: http://convertibles.dev

About us
Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecommerce since 2013: built and exited his own brand on Google Ads and CRO, then ran Google and YouTube for brands spending $50k to $500k+ a month on Google alone. The ads book today is around seven brands across the US, UK, EU and Australia, and it's growing.
The role
This is an apprenticeship with a real job attached. You work directly with Clay (x @ecomclay), learn how he runs accounts, and within 90 days you're running the weekly cycle on your first accounts yourself.
The weekly cycle, concretely:
• Monday: pull last week's numbers (Google Ads platform side plus the client's attribution tool - Triple Whale, Converge or Northbeam), update the reporting workbook, write the client update, produce the actions list. Exact campaign, exact change, why.
• Through the week: make the changes, watch pacing, check feeds and Merchant Center, build new campaigns (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube / Demand Gen).
• Client calls: sit in first, then run them.
How we work, so you know what you're signing up for
• YouTube and Demand Gen are the main event, not a side channel. We take a brand's winning Meta ads, recut them for YouTube, and scale. Accounts have gone from YouTube at 6-12% of media mix to 13-22%, at a return that held for over a year.
• Attribution-tool numbers decide YouTube, not platform numbers. If you've only ever judged campaigns on what Google Ads says, you'll learn a different lens.
• Everything gets a number. "Performance improved" is not a finding. "NC-CPA went from £38 to £30 on the same spend" is.
• AI is part of the workflow. Reporting workbooks, data pulls and first drafts are built with Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable working this way.
• There's a dev, CRO, QA and design team behind the ads. When a landing page or a feed needs fixing, someone fixes it.
Who fits
• 2-4 years hands-on in Google Ads for ecommerce. Your hands on the account, not managing someone whose hands are.
• You've run Search, Shopping and PMax on real budgets (at least one account at $20k+/month). You've at least touched YouTube or Demand Gen and want to go deep on it.
• Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel. You can look at eight weeks of campaign data and tell me what changed and why.
• You know what a Merchant Center disapproval is and how to fix it.
• You write clearly in English. You'll be writing to clients by week five.
• Curious, direct, not precious about being told you're wrong.
Not a fit: agency account managers who relay what the specialist did. Meta buyers who "also do Google". Anyone who needs the basics explained.
Hours
Full-time, 40h/wk. Your morning overlaps with Clay (he's UTC+8), your afternoon overlaps with UK/EU clients and the US East Coast. Flexible beyond that.
First 90 days
• Weeks 1-4: shadow. Pull the data, build the workbooks, sit on every call.
• Weeks 5-8: draft the Monday updates and actions lists for two accounts. Clay reviews before they go out.
• Weeks 9-12: own the weekly cycle and the check-in call on your first account.
Comp is reviewed at 90 days. The per-account bonus starts when you own an account.
What you get
Direct training from someone who's done this for 13 years, on his own money and then on clients'. A team behind you. A real path: run accounts, then lead the Google / YouTube lane.
How to apply
Keep it short. Answer the questions in the form with numbers, not adjectives. Shortlisted people do a paid 2-3 hour test task, then a call with Clay.

About Mecka AI
Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.
About the Role
Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.
As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.
What You Will Do
• Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

• Onboarding: Set partners up on the platform, issue devices and accounts, and train their teams on capture standards so they reach full output quickly.

• Hardware: Manage device allocation, tracking, replacements, and returns with our hardware and logistics teams, and keep inventory records accurate.

• Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels. Resolve problems yourself or route them to product, engineering, or finance before capture is disrupted, and pass on what partners need from the platform and devices.

• Performance and reporting: Monitor daily performance and quality across partners, including recorded, approved, and deliverable hours, recording counts, and QA rejection rates. Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

• Payments: Own partner payments and reconciliation, making sure hours are approved correctly and paid accurately and on time.

• Playbook: Build and improve the processes, checklists, and tools that keep partner operations running as the network grows.

What You Bring
• Experience: 3 to 5+ years in partner or vendor operations, supply or merchant onboarding, business operations, program or project management, or account management, ideally at a high-growth marketplace, delivery, or BPO company.

• Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

• Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.

• AI fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to pull and analyze data, draft partner communications, and streamline your own processes.

• Problem solving: A practical problem-solver who stays calm under pressure and sees problems through to resolution.

• Relationships: Strong interpersonal skills. You work well with both partners and internal teams.

• Agency: A high degree of initiative and comfort with ambiguity. This is an early and unstructured role, so you will set your own priorities, work without an established playbook, and build processes where none yet exists.

Even better if you have
• Industry: Background in data collection, AI training data, or BPO services.

• Field deployment: Experience with device deployment and inventory tracking across partner sites.

• Multi-country: Experience running partner operations across several countries and time zones.

• Languages: Working fluency in one or more of our regionsâ main business languages, alongside professional English.

full:
Headquarters: United States

About the role

For most people, health insurance happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give employees a healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them while employers get predictable costs.

It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology. We're just getting started. We look for people who use good judgment, take ownership, and care deeply about building something that matters.

Design is central to what makes Thatch stand out. We're building a brand that sets a new standard for healthcare. We're a small, collaborative team with high standards for craft, bold creative thinking, and a shared ambition to make something complex feel remarkably simple.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape Thatch's next chapter. We've built a product people love, and now we're ready to bring that same ambition to our visual identity. You'll develop creative concepts and bring them to life across web, campaigns, events, print, and more, helping define how people see and experience Thatch.

What you'll do

• Shape and evolve Thatch's visual identity, building a distinctive, cohesive brand across every touchpoint.

• Develop and execute creative concepts across our website, campaigns, digital content, events, print, and more.

• Own design projects end to end, from early exploration and creative direction through production and launch.

• Partner with Marketing, Product, and Design to translate business goals and complex ideas into compelling creative work.

• Present and advocate for your ideas, incorporating feedback while maintaining a high bar for craft and consistency.

• Collaborate with external creative partners when needed, bringing fresh ideas and approaches to how we tell our story.

What we are looking for

• 3–5 years of experience in brand, visual, or marketing design, ideally at a startup or high-growth company.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across typography, layout, color, and visual storytelling.

• Experience translating a brand identity into cohesive, high-quality work across digital and physical touchpoints.

• Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

• Ability to move quickly, iterate thoughtfully, and deliver polished work.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate across teams.

• Comfort with ambiguity, a sense of ownership, and the judgment to know when to challenge the brief.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

• Motion design, animation, or video experience.

• Ability to build and ship web experiences using HTML/CSS, Framer, or similar tools.

• Experience using AI tools to explore ideas and improve creative workflows.

• Experience helping a growing company evolve its brand.

What to expect

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, rigorous, and efficient. Most candidates complete it within three weeks.

• A 30-minute conversation with a recruiter.

• A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

• A portfolio review focused on your creative process, visual craft, and brand thinking.

• Functional interviews focused on creative collaboration, communication, and working style.

• A final conversation with a member of our executive team.

Learn more at www.veracode.com, on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.

You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. What you will do

• Work closely with product managers, developers and marketing, and represent design in discussions with the executive team.

• Measurably increase the user-centric mindset and UX maturity of the company: define how we measure it, report it to leadership and act on what you find.

• Own design craft, quality standards, and the coherence of the experience across all MapTiler products and services.

• Own the design roadmap, which runs in parallel to the product and marketing roadmaps.

• Make company-wide design decisions, set standards and quality, and speak up when they are not met.

What we expect from you

• At least 8 years of experience in UX, UI, or product design, including 3+ years in a design leadership role.

desc: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into…

Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. 

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.

• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.

• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.

• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.

• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.

• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.

• Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.

• Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.

• Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring

• A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.

• Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.

• A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary…

About Contra Labs

full:
About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
Â 
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Â 
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role
KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
Â 
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
Â 
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
Â 
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
Â 
What You'll Own
• Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

• Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

• Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

• Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

• Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

• Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

• Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
Â 

What We're Looking For
• 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

• Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

• Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

• Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

• Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

• Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
Â 

Nice to have
• Engineering or highly technical product background.

• Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

• Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Â 

Outcome
• Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

• Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

• Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

• AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

• Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

• Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
• Online assessment or practical task

• Technical interview

• CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

desc: About Magic Eden and Dicey Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sport…
full:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
What you'll do
• Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

• Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

• Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

• Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

• Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

• Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

• Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

• Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for
• Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

• Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

• AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

• High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

• Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

• Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit
• Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

• MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

• Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting
• Competitive, top-of-market compensation

• You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

• Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

• Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

desc: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restr…
full:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/

Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer

Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial

Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.

This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools.

You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials.

The work

You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals.

Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell.

• Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents.

• Decide what each batch should test and why.

• Source and analyse strong visual and structural references.

• Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction.

• Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads.

• Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level.

• Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop.

• Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance.

• Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output.

• Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests.

• Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch.

What you must be good at

• Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy

• Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation

• Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit

• Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page

• Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production

• Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation

• Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools

• Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish

• Fast, organised batch production

• Reading creative performance and choosing the next test

You are probably not right for this role if

• Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context.

• You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism.

• You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work.

• You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision.

• You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production.

• You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples.

• You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback.

What success looks like

Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow.

Compensation

The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month, based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator.

We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output.

How to apply

Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work.

• Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed.

• For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel.

• Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable.

• Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed.
